342:t_116:2.en:
$$五飛$$
(Even if you drag me into darkness again, I'll climb back out as many times as it takes! I have no doubts left!)

342:t_117:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(Whatever you do to break my heart, I will keep fighting...!)

342:t_117:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(I've already thrown everything away...! All I can do is fight until the only thing left, my life, runs out!)

342:t_118:0.en:
$$ノイン$$
(I hear the voices of the subordinates I lost... cursing my incompetence...)

342:t_118:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
(...Is this also that enemy's power...? Can humanity beat an enemy like this...?)

342:t_119:0.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
(I'm not scared... I'm not scared...! $$デュオ$$ and everyone are here...!)

342:t_119:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
(I-I have to fight...! I have to fight, I have to fight, I have to fight...!)

342:t_120:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Ever since the $$時空震動弾$$... I've been used to things not going my way...!」

342:t_120:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't know who you are, but trying to make me regret things or despair is useless! I'll teach you that!」

342:t_121:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Tch... I don't know how, but the memories of my $$ファイヤバグ$$ days are coming back so vividly...)

342:t_121:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(...If you're trying to crush me with self-loathing and regret, you've got the wrong man...)

342:t_121:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I've done more than enough of that alone! Whatever anyone says now, I'll just keep living my way!)

342:t_122:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you're scared, fall back. Someone who can't fight...」

342:t_122:4.en:
$n
「I'll overcome the fear inside me...! I always have... and I always will...!」

342:t_122:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
(As despair grows, so does hope... So the $$いがみ合う双子$$ name isn't just for show...)

342:t_123:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
(My despair will spread to every member of this ship's crew...)

342:t_123:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Even if I'm scared, sad, or in despair, as long as I sit in this chair, I'll fulfill my duty as captain...!)

342:t_123:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If I lose even that pride, I won't be able to go on living.)
